SELECT m.molecule_id, SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chlorine_count
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id;
